title: Console UI: audit timeline for rollout auto-actions (pause/rollback/suppress) with “why” + dashboard links
creator: Chloe Martin
description:
Build the Console UI experience for rollout audit events related to SLO-driven auto actions.

We’re adding automatic pause/rollback/suppress decisions in the rollout controller. This ticket covers the Console UI surface area so oncall + service owners can answer:
- What happened? (auto-pause vs auto-rollback vs suppressed)
- Why did it happen? (which SLO, what threshold/window, what scope)
- What did the system do? (traffic shifted? rollback executed? paused at step X?)
- Where do I look next? (links to Grafana dashboards + monitor definition)

Scope / UX
1) Rollout detail page: “Timeline” / “Events” section
- Add new event types rendered in the existing rollout timeline:
  - Auto action triggered: PAUSE | ROLLBACK | SHIFT_TO_BASELINE (A/B)
  - Auto action suppressed (suppression window active, incident override, admin override)
  - Monitor missing / stale (controller unable to evaluate)
- Each event should show:
  - Timestamp
  - Decision outcome + short reason string (human-readable)
  - Affected scope: route/service, model version, region, customer tier
  - Correlation IDs: rollout_id, decision_id (if exposed), monitor_id(s)

2) Event detail drawer/panel (DES-944)
- Clicking an event opens a detail drawer with:
  - Decision summary (“Paused rollout at step 3/7 due to fast-burn p95 latency breach”)
  - Policy snapshot (policy name/version; threshold; fast/slow windows; min sample size; holdoff/debounce)
  - Metrics snapshot (numbers as provided by API; if API provides “snapshot_ref”, show link text + any quick summary fields)
  - Links:
    - “Open rollout dashboards” (Grafana) pre-filtered to rollout_id + time range around event (±30m)
    - “Open SLO monitor” (monitor provider URL)
    - “Open logs” (if we have standardized log search URL; optional)
  - “Suppression” state:
    - If suppressed, show suppression reason + expiry; if admin-initiated, show actor + justification

3) Filtering + discoverability
- Timeline filter chips for: All | Auto actions | Suppressions | Monitor issues
- Optional: quick search by monitor_id / decision_id (if present)

4) Permissions / RBAC behavior
- Basic viewing should be available to anyone with rollout read access.
- Admin-only actions (create suppression / override) are NOT in scope for this ticket (ENG-4864 / ENG-48511), but the UI must correctly display admin-initiated suppression details without leaking restricted actor metadata if backend redacts.

API assumptions
- Depends on ENG-4831 (Console API: expose rollout auto-actions).
- UI should consume the new endpoint(s) and treat unknown event types as a generic “system event” to remain forward-compatible.
- The API should provide enough fields to render the “why” panel without additional calls.

Acceptance criteria
- Timeline renders auto action events for a rollout with correct ordering, labels, and timestamps.
- Event detail drawer displays:
  - Decision outcome + reason
  - Policy window/threshold fields (even if some are “N/A”)
  - Monitor status (ok | breached | stale | missing)
  - Dashboard + monitor links (when available)
- Missing/stale data states are handled gracefully:
  - If dashboard link missing, show disabled link + tooltip “dashboard not configured”.
  - If monitor_id missing, show “Monitor reference unavailable” and link is hidden.
- Works in staging E2E (ENG-4844) using synthetic SLO breach injection.
- Meets basic performance expectations: timeline fetch paginated; no >1s blocking render due to large event lists.

Out of scope (for this ticket)
- Creating/editing auto-rollback policy in the UI (DES-951 / policy editor work).
- Triggering rollback/pause manually from the UI.
- Building new dashboard content (handled in observability-pack PR / ENG-4840); we only link.

References
- PRD: Auto-rollback on SLO breach integration (Confluence)
- ADR-0128: rollout audit trail schema for auto actions
- Observability standard: rollouts SLO metrics naming/labeling
- Design: DES-944 Auto-rollback event detail panel

Notes / open questions
- Time range for dashboard deep-link: proposal is [event_time - 30m, event_time + 30m]. Confirm with Observability (Aisha) if this aligns with their dashboard variables.
- If API only provides “metrics_snapshot_ref” (blob ref) without inline values, do we want to show a minimal summary row (“Snapshot recorded”) until we can inline key fields?
- Copy: align terminology with controller semantics (pause vs rollback vs shift_to_baseline) per PM MVP thread.
comments: 2026-02-12 (Felix Schneider): Started UI spike behind `rolloutAutoActionsUI` feature flag. Waiting on ENG-4831 endpoint shape; meanwhile stubbed event types and drawer layout per DES-944.

2026-02-14 (Kenji Nakamura): Confirmed layout for detail drawer: 3 sections (Summary, Policy, Links) + collapsible “Raw payload” for internal users. Please keep “Raw payload” behind internal-only gate to avoid confusing customers later.

2026-02-18 (Aisha Bello): Dashboard deep-link should pass `var-rollout_id`, `var-service`, `from`, `to`. 30m window is fine; recommend default `from=event_time-45m` to capture slow-burn window context when applicable.

2026-02-20 (Felix Schneider): Implemented filter chips + event renderer. Added fallback UI for missing monitor/dashboard URLs. Next: wire real API response + pagination and add time-range deep link params.

2026-02-24 (Chloe Martin): Please ensure we display suppression reason + expiry prominently; SRE asked for quick visibility during oncall. Also: don’t show actor email if backend redacts; just show "Admin" and the justification string if present.

2026-02-26 (Felix Schneider): Wired to staging API (ENG-4831 deployed). Drawer now shows threshold/windows and monitor status. Still missing: min-sample + debounce fields (API returning null for older events) — handling with “N/A”. Adding unit tests for unknown event type rendering and link param formatting.
